name: Library clean-up
description: Moves films and series everyone has watched, or nobody has watched for a long time, to the holding folder, so your disks do not fill up. It never deletes, and each can be put back.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Move items each day
settings.hint: Once a day in quiet hours, moves what the rules find to the holding folder. Check Preview first: nothing moves until you activate this.

settings.label: Films watched by everyone
settings.hint: A film every person has watched.

settings.label: Last watched more than
settings.hint: For films watched by everyone and series that ended: how long ago anyone last watched it.

settings.label: Series that ended, every episode watched
settings.hint: A series Jellyfin says has ended, with every episode watched by everyone.

settings.label: Films and series nobody watches
settings.hint: Nobody has watched it for the time in Not watched for, and it was added longer ago than that, so nothing new is moved.

settings.label: Not watched for
settings.hint: For films and series nobody watches: how long since anyone watched it.

settings.label: People to leave out
settings.hint: Jellyfin user names whose watching does not count, such as a guest account. Everyone else who can sign in to Jellyfin counts.

settings.label: Favourites
settings.hint: Anything someone has marked as a favourite in Jellyfin.

settings.label: Something someone is part way through
settings.hint: A film or series in anyone's Continue watching, or a series someone has started.

settings.label: Films in a collection
settings.hint: A film in one of Jellyfin's collections, such as a film series you keep together.

settings.label: Keep tag
settings.hint: Anything with this tag in Jellyfin stays. Leave it empty to use no tag.

jobs.label: Move items to the holding folder

changed: **Clearer words:** **Libraries** says **Checked** for each library the rules check, the card says "Next check in quiet hours", and its hints name the setting they mean.
**Logo description:** where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Library clean-up logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.

fixed: **Jellyfin 12:** it sends Jellyfin's key the way Jellyfin 12 asks for it, so Jellyfin no longer refuses its requests where legacy authorisation is off. Older Jellyfin still works.

changed: **Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

added: **Rules:** films watched by everyone, last watched more than 90 days ago; series that ended with every episode watched; films and series nobody has watched for 12 months. Each a setting, for the libraries you choose.
**Always kept:** favourites, anything someone is part way through, films in a collection, and anything tagged keep.
**Preview** lists what would move and the space it frees. Nothing moves until you activate Move items each day.
**Never deletes:** it moves each item to media/.holding, keeping its folders, and Put back returns it.
**Reelix and Jellyfin are told:** Reelix stops following what moves, so it is not downloaded again, and follows it again when it is put back.
